tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is the mark's snow; dark sits just below the mark's navy ring, like the reference illustrations' grounds.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, table bodies. Dark is the mark's navy.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: input fields, segmented-control tracks, selected table rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control. Light is the mark's frost.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons; 3:1+ on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of budget and goal progress bars, empty chart gridlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on surface, surface-raised, surface-inset and every *-soft tint. The mark's navy ring / snow.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, dates, categories, captions. 5.3:1+ on surface, surface-raised and surface-inset in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The mark's steel blue. Charts, icons, large figures (24px+), the active nav indicator. Light value is 3.9:1 on surface: not for body text; use brand-strong.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected tabs, net-worth figures. As text: 5.9:1+ on surface and surface-raised. Light is the portrait's sunburst blue.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-strong fill (the primary button label). Never hard-code white: dark flips to navy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px with a 2px surface-coloured gap; 5.9:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: net-worth
tokens.usage: Net worth section: the headline figure, its trend line and section tag. Same hue as the brand on purpose: net worth is the app's centre.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Income section and money in: tags, chart series, inflow amounts. Text on surface, surface-raised and income-soft (not surface-inset in light). Dark is the teal reference illustration's glow.

tokens.name: income-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind income text: section tag, income row highlight. Dark is the teal reference illustration's ground.

tokens.name: spend
tokens.usage: Spending section, budgets, outflow categories; also the warning hue (budget near its limit). Text on surface, surface-raised and spend-soft. Dark is the portrait's orange.

tokens.name: spend-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind spend text and near-limit budget rows.

tokens.name: assets
tokens.usage: Assets section: account balances, holdings, allocation chart. Text on surface, surface-raised and assets-soft. Dark is the blue reference illustration's glow.

tokens.name: assets-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind assets text. Dark is the blue reference illustration's ground.

tokens.name: liabilities
tokens.usage: Liabilities section: loans, mortgages, card balances; also the negative/over-budget hue. Text on surface, surface-raised and liabilities-soft. Light is the red reference illustration's glow, darkened for text.

tokens.name: liabilities-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind liabilities text and over-budget rows. Dark is the red reference illustration's ground.

tokens.name: goals
tokens.usage: Goals section: savings targets, milestones, goal progress. Text on surface, surface-raised and goals-soft. Dark is the violet from the reference illustrations.

tokens.name: goals-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind goals text. Dark is the violet reference illustration's ground.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains and favourable deltas. Always paired with a + sign or an up arrow, never colour alone.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, unfavourable deltas, over-budget. Always paired with a − sign, a down arrow or the words 'Over by'.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Budget at 85–100% of its limit, upcoming bills. Pair with text ('$40 left').

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding and empty-state headlines.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The headline number of a screen: net worth, month's spend. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You spent $84 less on groceries than last month.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Merchant names, emphasised values in rows.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Amounts in tables and transaction rows. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata under a row title, helper text, chart axes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels above metric values and table headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value; tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, button horizontal padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of screen to title; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs inside dense tables, progress bars (with radius-full ends).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, the mark's disc, progress-bar ends.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on surface. Dark replaces the shadow with a line-coloured edge.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, bottom sheets.
